name: MINT_TOKEN
description: Mint additional fungible tokens, increasing the total supply. The token must have been created with a supply key. By default, the agent's operator key is used to sign. For tokens where the supply key differs, provide it via supplyPrivateKey.

implicitBehaviors.behavior: Supply key signing via freeze + sign pattern
implicitBehaviors.details: If supplyPrivateKey is provided, the transaction is frozen with freezeWith() then signed with the supply key. Otherwise operator key signs automatically.
After a successful mint, receipt.totalSupply contains the updated total supply of the token.

inputs.name: amount
inputs.describe: Amount of tokens to mint (in smallest unit)

inputs.name: supplyPrivateKey
inputs.describe: Supply key for the token (only needed if different from operator key)

preflightChecks.check: Warn on very large mints (>= 1,000,000,000 units)
preflightChecks.failDetails: Very large mint detected. Double-check this is intentional.

errorMap.details: This token was created without a supply key. Minting is permanently disabled.
Transaction signature is invalid. The supply key doesn't match.
The token ID does not exist on this network.
This token has been deleted and can no longer be minted.
Not enough HBAR to cover the transaction fee.
